svg.title: New Chitose Airport, Sapporo and Otaru by JR
svg.desc: A JR line runs from New Chitose Airport at lower right through Sapporo to Otaru at upper left. The fastest Rapid Airport service to Sapporo takes 37 minutes, or 33 minutes on a Special Rapid, costs ¥1,230 for an adult and runs six times an hour during the day; a reserved u-Seat costs ¥1,000 extra. Sapporo to Otaru takes about 35 minutes and costs ¥800. Some trains run through between Otaru and New Chitose Airport in as little as 73 minutes. The Sapporo panel lists Odori Park, the Clock Tower, Tanukikoji and Susukino one subway stop from Sapporo Station for ¥210; Clock Tower admission is ¥350 and opening hours are 8:45–17:10. Reach Mt. Moiwa Ropeway by streetcar to Ropeway Iriguchi and a free shuttle; a round trip costs ¥2,100. Shiroi Koibito Park is near Miyanosawa on the Tozai line and costs ¥1,200 for the paid area, open 10:00–18:00. Hokkaido Shrine is near Maruyama Koen on the Tozai line. The 2027 Sapporo Snow Festival runs 4–11 February at Odori, Tsudome and Susukino. Otaru Canal and Sakaimachi are walkable from Otaru Station; the Snow Light Path takes place in February.
